trades.name: Failed break below 6460 edge (e.g. LBAF of today's low 6462.75)
trades.quote: The edges of this upper distribution on ES are roughly 6460 and 6495. That means that failed breaks below 6460 (such as a LBAF of today’s low) is a long. This broadly targets 6482 and then 6495. [...] The primary trades are fading failed breaks of the edges on both. Longs should be preferred, particularly for ES, with shorts more reasonable on NQ as long as it remains relatively weak. These provide decent range and are solid B+/A- setups.

trades.name: Failed push above 6495 edge
trades.quote: A failed push above 6495 is technically a short to 6482 and 6460s but shorts must be kept on a tight leash if at all given broader bullish context. [...] The primary trades are fading failed breaks of the edges on both. Longs should be preferred, particularly for ES, with shorts more reasonable on NQ as long as it remains relatively weak. These provide decent range and are solid B+/A- setups.
trades.stop_hint: shorts must be kept on a tight leash if at all given broader bullish context

trades.name: Failed push below / hold of 6477
trades.quote: Outside of fading edges, the 6477 level on ES is of interest to me. If there was a spot I would get long near the middle of the range it would be on a failed push below (or technically a hold) of 6477.

trades.name: Failed break below 23885 edge (LBAF of 23885-23903)
trades.quote: The edges of the upper distribution on NQ are roughly 23885 and 23969 the bottom and top of our two weekly ranges respectively. We have seen multiple lows down into the 860s-870s but they have been quickly snapped up. Seeing a failed break of one side is usually a better trade than attempting to short or long an edge. The primary trades are fading failed breaks of the edges on both. Longs should be preferred, particularly for ES, with shorts more reasonable on NQ as long as it remains relatively weak. These provide decent range and are solid B+/A- setups.

trades.name: Breakdown short: lower highs/lower lows below 23885 (ideally 23864)
trades.quote: As mentioned, NQ is closer to breaking down. Lower highs and lower lows below 23885 (and ideally 23864) would be a cautious breakdown short looking for a liquidation. I would be quite cautious and selective, however, given what happens should sellers fail and 23885-23903 is reclaimed. One must be fully prepared to stop and flip long.
